name: services/instaddr/update
description:
Update an institutional address.

Currently calling this method with access token causes a method_forbidden error.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description:
LangDict with the name of the institutional address. No more than 100 characters.

Currently English name of the institutional address is ignored.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
An empty dictionary returned if the method has been executed successfully.
    Some keys may be added in the future.
errors: • object_not_found - institutional address could not be found; param_name is equal to inst_address_id.
